title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1970 1971 1973 Christmas + 1 Random Magazine
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 featuring issues from the 1970s.

Includes:

• January 1970
• November 1971
• December 1971 Christmas Issue
• November 1973 German Edition

Great group of vintage Playboy magazines for collectors, display, or completing a collection.

Magazines are in pre-owned vintage condition and show age-related wear including surface wear, scuffs, creases, edge/corner wear, and other signs of handling and storage. The November 1973 issue is a German-language edition.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents. Magazines are being sold together as one lot and exactly as pictured.
